transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got twenty finished pump skids staged and ready to go to North Site in Canada and South Site in Ohio. As we all know, the Port Delta route is closed, so we'll need to use a combination of inland rail and truck transport for this shipment. Before I can release the shipment, I need each of you to report your current requirements in turn -- customer fulfillment, export compliance, transportation planning, and packaging engineering. Please go ahead and share your findings so we can get everything recorded in the huddle record and I can approve the routing.
